title: BLOCKED PAD READS KEEP THE GAME RUNNING
why: An embedded browser may deny getGamepads with a SecurityError. Pad polling now handles that as an empty pad list, and the frame loop also catches a failing pad handler and releases pad-owned input. Watch in a playtest: inside the itch frame, both windows should keep animating and accept keyboard movement and mouse fire when pads are blocked; with pads allowed, the first pad still controls p2 and the second p1.
now: Blocked pad access keeps the game drawing and keyboard and mouse working.

edits.replacement:
// v28.xx (cw-cx-padpollguard): even an unexpected pad-handler failure must leave keyboard, mouse and the rest of this frame running.
  try{ pollPad(); }catch(_pp){ padRelease(); PAD.on=false; PAD.mx=0; PAD.my=0; PAD.aiming=false; RUMBLE.gp=null; RUMBLE.other=null; padBodyCls(); }
